title: Clobazam (Onfi / Sympazan) — maintenance dosing and NPO options

maintenance.doseText: Label dosing (LGS, ≥2 y): ≤30 kg: 5 mg/day → 10 mg/day from day 7 → 20 mg/day from day 14. >30 kg: 10 → 20 → 40 mg/day. >5 mg/day in 2 divided doses; escalate no faster than weekly
notes: Label indication is adjunctive treatment of LGS only (§1)
Steady state: clobazam 5 days, N-desmethylclobazam 9 days (§2.1)

renalNotes: No adjustment for mild or moderate renal impairment; essentially no experience in severe impairment or ESRD; dialyzability unknown (Onfi §2.6, §8.7)
hepatic: Mild–moderate (Child-Pugh 5–9): start 5 mg/day; titrate to half the Table 1 doses; may titrate to the maximum from day 21 (Onfi §2.7)
ivPo: Oral only — no parenteral formulation (Onfi §3; Sympazan §3)
enteral: Onfi tablets 10 and 20 mg: whole, broken in half along the score, or crushed and mixed in applesauce (Onfi §2.3)
Onfi oral suspension 2.5 mg/mL; shake well; use the supplied syringe and adapter (Onfi §2.3, §3)
Sympazan oral film 5, 10, 20 mg: on top of the tongue; don't give with liquids; one film at a time; bioequivalent to clobazam tablets (Sympazan §2.3, §12.3)
Tube administration not addressed in label — confirm with pharmacy
levels: Clobazam 30–300 ng/mL; N-desmethylclobazam 300–3000 ng/mL — AES 2024 summary Table 1 (range from AES Treatments Committee clinical experience, not the label)
interactions: Opioids: profound sedation, respiratory depression, death — limit dose and duration (boxed warning; Onfi §7.1)
Strong (fluconazole, fluvoxamine, ticlopidine) or moderate (omeprazole) CYP2C19 inhibitors: up to 5-fold ↑ N-desmethylclobazam — dose adjustment may be needed (Onfi §7.4, §12.3)
Cenobamate ↑ N-desmethylclobazam — consider a lower clobazam dose (Xcopri Table 5)
Phenobarbital, phenytoin, carbamazepine: no significant change in clobazam or N-desmethylclobazam PK (Onfi §12.3)
CYP2D6 substrates: lower doses may be needed (Onfi §7.3)
pearls: Boxed warnings: opioids; abuse, misuse and addiction; dependence and withdrawal
Taper: ↓ total daily dose by 5–10 mg/day weekly; abrupt stop can cause life-threatening withdrawal (Onfi §2.2)
Elderly or known CYP2C19 poor metabolizers: start 5 mg/day; titrate to half the Table 1 doses (Onfi §2.4–2.5)
sources: Onfi (clobazam) tablets and oral suspension US prescribing information. Lundbeck; revised 10/2026 (user-supplied label)
Sympazan (clobazam) oral film US prescribing information. Aquestive Therapeutics; revised 12/2025 (user-supplied label)
Xcopri (cenobamate) tablets US prescribing information. SK Life Science; revised 8/2025 (user-supplied label)
